# Synthetic illustrative drafts

These four drafts preceded the actual local PostgreSQL evidence. Their numbers,
windows, resource names and deployment labels are synthetic examples, not AWS
measurements. Query/session source excerpts were copied from the working tree;
that did not make the example metrics measured. They are retained as draft history,
not active evaluation inputs or model-result fixtures. The active catalog now uses
local runner data and explicitly records missing time/alarm metadata.
